import socket, select, time, sys, re

SOCK='/tmp/alpine-serial.sock'
log=open('/tmp/alpine-console.log','ab')
buf=b''

def read_until(patterns, timeout=120, label=''):
    global buf
    if isinstance(patterns,str):
        patterns=[patterns]
    pats=[re.compile(p.encode() if isinstance(p,str) else p, re.I) for p in patterns]
    end=time.time()+timeout
    while time.time()<end:
        for p in pats:
            m=p.search(buf)
            if m:
                out=buf; buf=buf[m.end():]
                log.write(out); log.flush()
                return (p.pattern, out.decode('utf-8','replace'))
        r,_,_=select.select([s],[],[],1.0)
        if r:
            d=s.recv(65536)
            if not d:
                raise RuntimeError('serial connection closed')
            buf+=d
    log.write(buf); log.flush()
    raise RuntimeError('TIMEOUT waiting for %r (%s). Recent output:\n%s' % (patterns,label,buf.decode('utf-8','replace')[-3000:]))

s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect(SOCK)

# wake console
s.sendall(b'\r')
p,out=read_until([r'login:', r'# '], timeout=60, label='initial prompt')
print('INITIAL MATCH:', p)
if 'login:' in p:
    s.sendall(b'root\r')
    p,out=read_until([r'Password:', r'# '], timeout=60, label='after username')
    print('AFTER ROOT MATCH:', p, repr(out[-200:]))
    if 'Password' in p:
        s.sendall(b'\r')
        p,out=read_until([r'# '], timeout=60, label='after empty password')
        print('AFTER EMPTY PASS:', p)

def run(cmd, marker, timeout=120):
    payload=cmd+'\necho %s\n' % marker
    s.sendall(payload.encode()+b'\r')
    p,out=read_until([marker], timeout=timeout, label='marker '+marker)
    # consume prompt too
    p2,out2=read_until([r'# '], timeout=30, label='prompt after '+marker)
    print('=== [%s] ok ===' % marker)
